p.PACKAGE-INSTALLS-THE-SAME-COMMIT-DOC-DIS: A vibevm `flow` package that installs a small, load-bearing discipline: a project's **setup and runtime documentation is updated in the same commit** as any change to the toolchain, prerequisites, environment, paths, or bootstrap steps.

p.setup-docs-are-the-file-someone-opens-wh: Setup docs are the file someone opens when the build breaks or the environment is wrong.

p.THE-UPDATE-IS-NEVER-SEPARABLE-FROM-THE-C: A deferred doc update is exactly the drift these files exist to prevent — so the update is never separable from the change that necessitates it.

item.CONTENT-THE-FULL-PROTOCOL: `spec/flows/dev-runtime-docs/DEV-RUNTIME-DOCS-PROTOCOL.md` — the obligation, why it is pinned in the project's foundational conventions, the contributor-vs-runtime audience split, and how to keep the docs honest.

item.CONTENT-THE-BOOT-SNIPPET: `spec/boot/58-flow-dev-runtime-docs.md` — the boot snippet loaded at session start: the rule and the never-do list.

p.UNINSTALL-REMOVES-EVERY-FILE-THE-PACKAGE: Uninstalling removes every file the package wrote, including the boot snippet.

p.extracted-from-vibevms-own-foundational-: Extracted from vibevm's own foundational conventions (PROP-000 §19): the obligation that a change touching prerequisites/toolchain/env/paths ships with the matching guide update in the same commit, pinned centrally so it is met during the boot-sequence read-order.
